text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Inference API p99 spike observed (current p99 ~ 2.3s, baseline 350ms). Streaming tail stalls reported by multiple customers. Paging @mike_oncall :rotating_light:

mike_oncall: on it. digging into dashboards now. which routes?

sara_prod: seeing elevated p95 and p99 across /v1/generate and /v1/chat/stream. p95 ~ 520ms, p99 ~ 2.3s for the last 10m. Error rate stable but a lot of long tails. Customer-reported streaming stalls (frame drops) from 2 customers.

alan_ops: grabbing traces. initial flamegraphs show long waits in token-store auth DB and config fetchs (feature flag checks). possible rate-coordination with auth cache invalidation.

mike_oncall: confirm if this is auth-token read latency or our control plane configfetch. Sara, can you paste a quick query?

sara_prod: quick logs snippet:```
2026-03-15T08:22:43Z INFO request_id=abcd123 route=/v1/chat/stream step=auth-token read_ms=980
2026-03-15T08:22:43Z INFO request_id=abcd123 route=/v1/chat/stream step=config-fetch ms=450
2026-03-15T08:22:43Z WARN request_id=efgh456 route=/v1/generate step=kvcache miss=true
```

alan_ops: that auth read_ms ~980 is the big one. token-store p99 has jumped. I'm seeing a small increase in DB queue length on the control-plane auth DB. could be a retry storm from a config rollout.

kevin_devex:FYI we rolled a featureflag change to enable new embedding caching two deploys ago (08:15), targeted rollout 10%. Could be correlated.

mike_oncall: timeline matches. Rollout at 08:15, first p99 uptick at 08:20. roll it back?

alan_ops: recommend two-step: 1) temporary rollback of the flag to stop extra control-plane reads, 2) short-circuit token-store read path for warm clients (cache TTL bump) to cut p99.

jess_cs: two customers reported audio streaming stalls and one customer facing full request timeouts (their requests hit p99). CS note drafted to affected customers (only two, internal IDs C-3289, C-3410). Will update status page once we have mitigation.

mike_oncall: initiating rollback of the feature flag now. @kevin_devex can you flip?

kevin_devex: flipping flag to off for rollout groups. command:```bash
./flagctl set embedding-caching-new false --env=prod --groups=rollout
```
kevin_devex: flipped. deploy-bot: flag-change detected by feature-gateway at 08:27:12

deploy-bot: [AUTO] feature-gateway observed change embedding-caching-new=false; propagated to control plane in 12s.

alan_ops: seeing reduced config-fetch traffic but token-store still slow for a short window —cache invalidation spike. I'm going to bump token-store local TTLs for frontends to 30s to avoid hitting DB for in-flight sessions.

mike_oncall: please post the exact command and expected rollback window. If we still see p99 high after TTL bump, we escalate DB.

alan_ops: TTL bump done (frontends):```yaml
service: inference-frontend
config_override: token_ttl_secs: 30
```
This will take ~20s to roll.

sara_prod: post-roll actions: p95 down to ~420ms after flag flip and TTL bump, p99 trending down but still at ~1.1s. streaming stalls reduced but one remaining customer reporting partial frames.

mike_oncall: good. we'll hold and monitor 10m. Notify CS to send the advisory to the 2 customers. Jess, send the note and mark impact as "degraded streaming - small set".

jess_cs: sending now. status page update: "Mitigation in progress: feature flag rollback and cache TTL adjustments; partial streaming degradation for small number of customers. Engineers investigating root cause."

alan_ops: digging deeper on token-store - found increased DB read latency on a specific shard: index hotness on token_lookup_by_client_id. I see unusually high fanout to that index after cache invalidation. Likely TTL bump caused short-term fanout; we need DB throttle window to avoid retry storm.

mike_oncall: can we add a short windowed client-side rate limiter to avoid thundering herd hitting the token DB? Potential runtime hotfix: add 100ms jitter and backoff.

alan_ops: yes. Patching frontend client layer:```diff
- readToken(client_id)
+ readToken(client_id) // add jitter/backoff up to 200ms on cache miss
```
Patch pushed to canary in 2min.

sara_prod: canary metrics look good. p99 at canary nodes ~320ms. Frontend fleet will roll in ~3min.

mike_oncall: rolling to 30% now, watch for error rate. If stable, roll to 100%.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] rollout frontend-hotfix-jitter v1.0.3 -> 30% @ 08:34:10

sara_prod: after 100% rollout p99 across fleet back to ~380ms, streaming stalls resolved for the two customers.

jess_cs: customers notified and tickets updated; both customers acknowledged the note and said service seems better.

alan_ops: root cause summary draft: feature-flag rollout triggered cache invalidation pattern leading to token-store DB read fanout; combined with low cache TTLs caused retry/fanout and DB queueing -> p99 spike and streaming tail stalls. Mitigations applied: rollback flag, increased frontend token TTL, added client-side jitter/backoff, and temporary DB throttle window for token shard.

mike_oncall: next steps before handoff: 1) DB team to review token_store index hotness and add a read-side lane/replica for hot clients; 2) product to re-evaluate rollout strategy for embedding-caching-new (staged ramp + warm caches); 3) implement longer-term control-plane caching for feature flags to avoid configfetch fanout.

alan_ops: opening a follow-up task: INF-4621 "Token-store shard read replica + index tuning" and INF-4622 "Flag rollout hardening: staged warm caches".

mike_oncall: taking notes for postmortem. tagging oncall handoff to @alan_ops for the next shift. Handing off at 08:50.

alan_ops: ack. will continue monitoring for the next hour and start DB tuning ticket. Summary will be added to the incident doc.

incident-bot: [INCIDENT] Severity: P2. Status: mitigated. Next update scheduled in 60m or on new alerts.

mike_oncall: thanks team. leaving channel for handoff. @jess_cs please prepare customer follow-up copy for tomorrow with root cause summary and timing.

jess_cs: will do. adding follow-up items to CS tracker.

kevin_devex: lesson: feature flag rollouts need pre-warm for control-plane reads. I'll add a template to rollout playbooks.

mike_oncall: closing thread for now, will attach logs and traces to INF-4621.

alan_ops: attaching trace url: https://internal-tracing/trace/abcd1234.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] incident-channel archived message at 08:50:05.
